WITH filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT k_symbol, amount
  FROM `order`
  WHERE amount > 2802
),
purpose_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    k_symbol,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount
  FROM filtered_orders
  GROUP BY k_symbol
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_figure
  FROM purpose_averages
)
SELECT 
  pa.k_symbol,
  pa.avg_amount,
  pa.avg_amount - oa.overall_figure as excess
FROM purpose_averages pa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE pa.avg_amount > oa.overall_figure
ORDER BY pa.k_symbol
